source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 10 (PDF 182-204), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 10 (Trigonometric Identities) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Using the distance formula, show that \(A(1, 1)\), \(B(4, 5)\) and \(C(8, 2)\) are the vertices of a right isosceles triangle, and find its area. (5 marks)
(Distance formula se dikhayein ke \(A(1, 1)\), \(B(4, 5)\) aur \(C(8, 2)\) right isosceles triangle ke vertices hain, aur us ka area nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Teeno sides nikalein, do ka muqabla karein aur Pythagoras check karein.

book_ref.quote: The order of subtraction does not matter, because the differences are squared.

steps: \(AB = BC\) (isosceles); \(25 + 25 = 50 = AC^{2}\), is liye \(B\) par right angle.
blocks.final_answer: Right isosceles triangle (\(B\) par right angle); area \(= \frac{25}{2}\) square units.

blocks.prompt:
2 Prove the fundamental law of trigonometry \(\cos(\alpha - \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta\) for \(\alpha > \beta > 0\), using the unit circle and the distance formula. (5 marks)
(Unit circle aur distance formula se fundamental law \(\cos(\alpha - \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta\) ko \(\alpha > \beta > 0\) ke liye sabit karein.)
blocks.explanation: Unit circle ki do chords lein jo barabar angle \(\alpha - \beta\) banati hain; un ki lambaiyon ke square barabar karein.

book_ref.quote: Two sides and the included angle are equal, which is the SAS rule.

steps: Unit circle par \(A(\cos\alpha, \sin\alpha)\), \(B(\cos\beta, \sin\beta)\), \(C(\cos(\alpha - \beta), \sin(\alpha - \beta))\), \(D(1, 0)\); \(m\angle AOB = m\angle COD = \alpha - \beta\).

blocks.prompt:
3 Starting from the fundamental law and the results \(\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = \sin\theta\), \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = \cos\theta\), prove that \(\sin(\alpha + \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta\), and check it for \(\alpha = \beta = 45^{\circ}\). (5 marks)
(Fundamental law aur \(\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = \sin\theta\), \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = \cos\theta\) se sabit karein ke \(\sin(\alpha + \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta\), aur \(\alpha = \beta = 45^{\circ}\) par check karein.)
blocks.explanation: Sine ko complement ke cosine mein likhein aur angle ko farq ki shakal mein todein.

book_ref.quote: the cosine of an angle is the sine of its complement

blocks.prompt:
4 Prove that \(\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \dfrac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\). Use it to find \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) when \(\tan\alpha = \frac{2}{3}\) and \(\tan\beta = \frac{1}{5}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \dfrac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\). Phir \(\tan\alpha = \frac{2}{3}\), \(\tan\beta = \frac{1}{5}\) par \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: tan ko sin/cos likhein, kholein, aur upar neeche \(\cos\alpha\cos\beta\) se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: Why divide by \(\cos\alpha\cos\beta\)? Because

blocks.prompt:
5 If \(\sin\alpha = \frac{4}{5}\) and \(\cos\beta = \frac{5}{13}\), where \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) are acute, find \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\), \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\) and \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\). In which quadrant does the terminal side of \(\alpha + \beta\) lie? (5 marks)
(Agar \(\sin\alpha = \frac{4}{5}\) aur \(\cos\beta = \frac{5}{13}\) hon (\(\alpha, \beta\) acute) to \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\), \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\) aur \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) nikalein. \(\alpha + \beta\) ki terminal side kis quadrant mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baqi ratios nikalein (dono musbat), sum formulas lagayein, phir nishanon se quadrant batayein.

book_ref.quote: From the single law of 10.1.1 the book now deduces ten results

steps: sin musbat, cos manfi: quadrant II.

blocks.prompt:
6 Without using tables, find the value of \(\sin 420^{\circ}\cos 390^{\circ} + \cos(-660^{\circ})\sin(-330^{\circ})\). (5 marks)
(Tables ke baghair \(\sin 420^{\circ}\cos 390^{\circ} + \cos(-660^{\circ})\sin(-330^{\circ})\) ki qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har ratio ko odd/even multiple rule aur quadrant ke nishan se chhota karein, phir jama karein.

book_ref.quote: write each angle as \(n \times 90^{\circ} \pm \theta\) with \(\theta\) acute

blocks.prompt:
7 Prove that \(\dfrac{\sin(\pi - \theta)\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \theta\right)}{\cos(2\pi - \theta)} + \dfrac{\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \theta\right)}{\sin(\pi + \theta)} = 0\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\dfrac{\sin(\pi - \theta)\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \theta\right)}{\cos(2\pi - \theta)} + \dfrac{\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \theta\right)}{\sin(\pi + \theta)} = 0\).)
blocks.explanation: Har allied ratio ko sahi nishan ke saath \(\theta\) ke ratio mein badlein, phir har fraction simplify karein.

book_ref.quote: Taking the sign from the new ratio

blocks.prompt:
8 If \(\tan\alpha = -\frac{4}{3}\) with the terminal side of \(\alpha\) in quadrant II, and \(\sin\beta = -\frac{5}{13}\) with the terminal side of \(\beta\) in quadrant III, find \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\), \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\), \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) and the quadrant of \(\alpha + \beta\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(\tan\alpha = -\frac{4}{3}\) (\(\alpha\) quadrant II mein) aur \(\sin\beta = -\frac{5}{13}\) (\(\beta\) quadrant III mein) hon to \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\), \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\), \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) aur \(\alpha + \beta\) ka quadrant nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Quadrant ke nishan ke saath baqi ratios nikalein, phir sum formulas.

book_ref.quote: Forgetting the quadrant when taking a square root

steps: \(\tan(\alpha + \beta) = -\frac{33}{56}\); sin manfi, cos musbat: quadrant IV.

blocks.prompt:
9 If \(\alpha + \beta = 45^{\circ}\), prove that \((1 + \tan\alpha)(1 + \tan\beta) = 2\). Hence find the value of \((1 + \tan 20^{\circ})(1 + \tan 25^{\circ})\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(\alpha + \beta = 45^{\circ}\) ho to sabit karein ke \((1 + \tan\alpha)(1 + \tan\beta) = 2\). Phir \((1 + \tan 20^{\circ})(1 + \tan 25^{\circ})\) ki qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\alpha + \beta = 45^{\circ}\) ke dono taraf tan lein, fraction hatayein aur 1 jama karein.

book_ref.quote: In the same way \(\frac{\cos x - \sin x}{\cos x + \sin x} = \tan(45^{\circ} - x)\).

blocks.prompt:
10 Express \(15\sin\theta + 8\cos\theta\) in the form \(r\sin(\theta + \phi)\) with \(\phi\) in quadrant I. Hence find the greatest and least values of \(15\sin\theta + 8\cos\theta\), and \(\sin\theta\) when the greatest value occurs (\(0^{\circ} < \theta < 90^{\circ}\)). (5 marks)
(\(15\sin\theta + 8\cos\theta\) ko \(r\sin(\theta + \phi)\) ki form mein likhein (\(\phi\) quadrant I mein). Phir is ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti qeemat, aur sab se bari qeemat par \(\sin\theta\) nikalein (\(0^{\circ} < \theta < 90^{\circ}\)).)
blocks.explanation: \(r\sin\theta\cos\phi + r\cos\theta\sin\phi\) se muqabla, \(r\) aur \(\phi\) nikalein, phir \(-1 \le \sin \le 1\).

book_ref.quote: \(a\sin\theta + b\cos\theta = r\sin(\theta + \phi)\), \(r = \sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}}\)

blocks.prompt:
11 If \(\cos\alpha = -\frac{3}{5}\) and \(90^{\circ} < \alpha < 180^{\circ}\), find \(\sin 2\alpha\), \(\cos 2\alpha\) and \(\tan 2\alpha\). In which quadrant does the terminal side of \(2\alpha\) lie? (5 marks)
(Agar \(\cos\alpha = -\frac{3}{5}\) aur \(90^{\circ} < \alpha < 180^{\circ}\) ho to \(\sin 2\alpha\), \(\cos 2\alpha\) aur \(\tan 2\alpha\) nikalein. \(2\alpha\) ki terminal side kis quadrant mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Quadrant ke nishan se \(\sin\alpha\) nikalein, double angle formulas lagayein, nishanon se quadrant batayein.

book_ref.quote: only \(\cos\alpha\) known: use

steps: sin aur cos dono manfi: quadrant III.

blocks.prompt:
12 Prove that \(\dfrac{1 + \sin 2\theta + \cos 2\theta}{1 + \sin 2\theta - \cos 2\theta} = \cot\theta\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\dfrac{1 + \sin 2\theta + \cos 2\theta}{1 + \sin 2\theta - \cos 2\theta} = \cot\theta\).)
blocks.explanation: \(1 + \cos 2\theta = 2\cos^{2}\theta\), \(1 - \cos 2\theta = 2\sin^{2}\theta\), \(\sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta\) se factorize karein.

book_ref.quote: Rearranging the last two forms gives two very useful results

blocks.prompt:
13 If \(\cos\alpha = -\frac{119}{169}\) and \(180^{\circ} < \alpha < 270^{\circ}\), find \(\sin\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\), \(\cos\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\) and \(\tan\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(\cos\alpha = -\frac{119}{169}\) aur \(180^{\circ} < \alpha < 270^{\circ}\) ho to \(\sin\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\), \(\cos\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\) aur \(\tan\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) ka quadrant dekhein, phir sahi nishan ke saath half angle identities.

book_ref.quote: The sign is chosen from the quadrant of

steps: \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) quadrant II mein: sin musbat, cos aur tan manfi.

blocks.prompt:
14 Using half angle identities, find the exact values of \(\sin 157.5^{\circ}\), \(\cos 157.5^{\circ}\) and \(\tan 157.5^{\circ}\). (5 marks)
(Half angle identities se \(\sin 157.5^{\circ}\), \(\cos 157.5^{\circ}\) aur \(\tan 157.5^{\circ}\) ki exact qeematein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(157.5^{\circ} = \frac{315^{\circ}}{2}\), \(\cos 315^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\); \(157.5^{\circ}\) quadrant II mein.

book_ref.quote: Plus inside goes with cosine, minus inside goes with sine.

blocks.prompt:
15 Prove that \(\sin 3\alpha = 3\sin\alpha - 4\sin^{3}\alpha\), and verify it for \(\alpha = 30^{\circ}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\sin 3\alpha = 3\sin\alpha - 4\sin^{3}\alpha\), aur \(\alpha = 30^{\circ}\) par verify karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(3\alpha = 2\alpha + \alpha\) likhein, sum formula, phir sirf sines wale double angle formulas.

book_ref.quote: The whole idea of every proof below is one line

blocks.prompt:
16 Prove that \(\cos 3\alpha = 4\cos^{3}\alpha - 3\cos\alpha\), and verify it for \(\alpha = 60^{\circ}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\cos 3\alpha = 4\cos^{3}\alpha - 3\cos\alpha\), aur \(\alpha = 60^{\circ}\) par verify karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(3\alpha = 2\alpha + \alpha\), sum formula, phir sirf cosines wale double angle formulas.

book_ref.quote: only cosines; the signs are the other way round

blocks.prompt:
17 Show that \(\sin^{4}\theta + \cos^{4}\theta = \dfrac{3 + \cos 4\theta}{4}\), an expression in first powers of multiples of \(\theta\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(\sin^{4}\theta + \cos^{4}\theta = \dfrac{3 + \cos 4\theta}{4}\) (\(\theta\) ke multiples ki pehli powers).)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin^{2}\theta + \cos^{2}\theta = 1\) se square poora karein, phir \(\sin^{2}2\theta = \frac{1 - \cos 4\theta}{2}\).

book_ref.quote: To remove powers use \(\cos^{2}\theta = \frac{1 + \cos 2\theta}{2}\)

blocks.prompt:
18 If \(\tan\theta = \frac{3}{4}\) and \(\theta\) is acute, find \(\sin 2\theta\) and \(\cos 2\theta\) through \(\tan\theta\) alone, and find \(\sin 3\theta\) and \(\cos 3\theta\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(\tan\theta = \frac{3}{4}\) aur \(\theta\) acute ho to sirf \(\tan\theta\) se \(\sin 2\theta\) aur \(\cos 2\theta\) nikalein, aur \(\sin 3\theta\), \(\cos 3\theta\) bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin 2\theta\), \(\cos 2\theta\) ki tan forms; phir \(\sin\theta\), \(\cos\theta\) se triple angle formulas.

book_ref.quote: they express \(\sin 2\theta\) and \(\cos 2\theta\) through \(\tan\theta\) alone

blocks.prompt:
19 Starting from \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\) and \(\sin(\alpha - \beta)\), prove that \(\sin P + \sin Q = 2\sin\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\) and \(\sin P - \sin Q = 2\cos\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\). (5 marks)
(\(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\) aur \(\sin(\alpha - \beta)\) se sabit karein ke \(\sin P + \sin Q = 2\sin\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\) aur \(\sin P - \sin Q = 2\cos\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\).)
blocks.explanation: Dono formulas jama aur tafreeq karein, phir \(\alpha + \beta = P\), \(\alpha - \beta = Q\).

book_ref.quote: Adding (i) and (ii) we get

blocks.final_answer: Sines ke dono sum-to-product formulas sabit.

blocks.prompt:
20 Prove that \(\cos 10^{\circ} + \cos 110^{\circ} + \cos 130^{\circ} = 0\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\cos 10^{\circ} + \cos 110^{\circ} + \cos 130^{\circ} = 0\).)
blocks.explanation: Aakhri do terms ko sum-to-product formula se jorein.

book_ref.quote: Use \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\), \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\)

blocks.prompt:
21 Prove that \(\sin\theta + \sin 2\theta + \sin 3\theta = \sin 2\theta\,(1 + 2\cos\theta)\), and check it for \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\sin\theta + \sin 2\theta + \sin 3\theta = \sin 2\theta\,(1 + 2\cos\theta)\), aur \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) par check karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin 3\theta\) ko \(\sin\theta\) ke saath jorein, phir \(\sin 2\theta\) common.

book_ref.quote: Sum to product: half sum and half difference
